description: This file defines the API and data structures for asynchronous data fetching in the lighttpd server, including fetch database management, entry handling, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: liFetchDatabase
classes.description: Represents a fetch database instance managing asynchronous data entries.

classes.name: liFetchCallbacks
classes.description: Holds callback functions for lookup, revalidation, refresh, and cleanup operations.

classes.name: liFetchEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual fetch data entry with key and associated data.

classes.name: liFetchWait
classes.description: Represents a wait handle for asynchronous fetch operations.

methods.name: li_fetch_database_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for the fetch database.

methods.name: li_fetch_database_release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for the fetch database.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for a fetch entry.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for a fetch entry.

methods.name: li_fetch_invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry by key.

methods.name: li_fetch_database_new
methods.description: Creates a new fetch database with specified callbacks and cache sizes.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_ready
methods.description: Marks a fetch entry as ready for use.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_refresh
methods.description: Triggers a background refresh of a fetch entry.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_refresh_skip
methods.description: Triggers a new lookup for a fetch entry if the old one is invalid.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_refresh_ready
methods.description: Marks a new fetch entry as ready to replace the old one.

methods.name: li_fetch_entry_revalidate
methods.description: Revalidates a fetch entry; returns TRUE if still valid.

methods.name: li_fetch_get
methods.description: Retrieves a fetch entry asynchronously by key, with optional job reference.

methods.name: li_fetch_get2
methods.description: Retrieves a fetch entry asynchronously with a wakeup callback.

methods.name: li_fetch_cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing fetch wait operation.
